name: br-regional-incentives
description: Determine whether a Brazilian establishment, production line or shipment can use regional incentives in calendar 2026. Covers SUDAM and SUDENE territorial and priority-sector screening, approved projects, lucro da exploração, Receita recognition, the LC 224/2025 reduction and grandfathering conditions, and deposits for reinvestment. Distinguishes the Manaus Free Trade Zone, Western Amazon and Free Trade Areas, SUFRAMA registration, product-specific PPB, shipment internment and separate Amazonas state approvals. Includes conditional computations and operational evidence, application and reporting routes. Trigger on Zona Franca de Manaus, SUFRAMA, SUDAM, SUDENE, reinvestimento, lucro da exploração, PPB, Amazônia Ocidental, ALC, regional incentives and incentive project eligibility.
